purpose: Honest agent-experience review of the source-of-truth CLI/hooks, written while genuinely using the tool. Review artifact only -- NOT wired into the tool.
reviewer: Claude (acting as the primary agent using SoT)
bottom_line: Zero open defects. The two real bugs found were fixed this session. Everything else is minor doc/UX polish, not a malfunction. (An earlier draft of this file padded the nit list and even listed 'capture is advisory' as a defect -- it is not: the agent judges when to capture, by design.)

real_defects_found_and_fixed.title: Pre-text was empty on interrupted/canceled turns
real_defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: The synthetic '[Request interrupted by user]' type==user event was treated as the last-user-prompt boundary, excluding the preceding agent output.
real_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Exclude interrupt markers from boundary detection (no leak into content). Regression tests with a realistic marker transcript. Commit 7375e9c.
real_defects_found_and_fixed.verification: Live transcript: 0 -> 28357 chars captured; marker not present.

real_defects_found_and_fixed.title: add-path mis-handled absolute paths; non-existent path dumped a traceback
real_defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: pathlib's '/' join collapses an absolute right operand, so project_directory_for('/abs') returned '/abs' (which exists), and the path arg was consumed as a bogus project-id override.
real_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Restrict positional project override to a bare token (not absolute, no path separator); catch the non-existent-path ValueError for a clean error. Regression tests. Commit 2772d36.
real_defects_found_and_fixed.verification: Live: add-path with the absolute repo path returns 'added'; 164 tests pass.

minor_doc_ux_nits_not_defects: Unknown-op / bad-parent messages come from the LLM reviewer rather than a deterministic pre-check; wording is inconsistent (a deterministic validator exists but runs after).
Session-id + transcript-path discovery uses the sentinel-echo trick; could be documented or auto-resolved.
'0' reads two ways at the --add call site (raw_input_id 0 vs parent '0' = top-level).
reorder_children uses parent_id while reparent/remove/modify_reference use node_id.
'0>1' / 'e>9' parent>child path notation in change-set output is not explained inline.
Per-turn guidance is a dense single block (improved this session; still one line).
positive_observations: Reviewer correctly refused to create nodes lacking explicit user backing ('user said test paths, not create nodes').
MUST-CAPTURE guidance + instruction-lifecycle groups demonstrably changed behavior live this session.

All CLI paths/ops exercised successfully: read, search-nodes, show-tree/--show-all, show-top-level, set-mode (live/deferred/none), flush-deferred, pretext (range/--none/--all), add, add_group, combo --new-group, reparent, reorder_children, modify_reference, remove, add-path (absolute, post-fix).
